epics.title: Source custody and engineering foundation
epics.disposition: Source/issue/runtime records supersede foundation-only status; complete historical recovery, performer/phrase verification and final acceptance remain open.

epics.title: Creative notes to actionable revision proposals
epics.disposition: Authored recipe and note-review paths exist. Generic natural-language interpretation, archived proposal-schema execution and automatic artistic acceptance are not claimed.

epics.title: Audio restoration and sound authorship
epics.disposition: Processing/candidates exist; source-listened words, matched listening, full mix/room/foley and artistic selection remain gates.

epics.title: Dialogue, performance, and editorial revision
epics.disposition: Paired timing and delayed gesture mechanisms exist. Qualified phrase edges, observed performance effect and reconstructed acting are not established by these mechanisms.

epics.title: Animated typography and motion design
epics.disposition: Authored typography is retained; verified captions, tracked-surface typography and final text score require their own acceptance.

epics.title: Tracked virtual cinematography and detail reconstruction
epics.disposition: Related backlog links are partial, not one-to-one coverage. Tracking/crop diagnostics exist; stabilization, full coverage and reconstructed high-resolution detail remain distinct obligations. Resampling is not recovered detail.

epics.title: Compositing, character regions, and scene transformation
epics.disposition: Region/layer mechanisms exist; final contours, occlusion, room continuity, shadow/reflection separation and motion acceptance remain explicit.

epics.title: Processing execution, comparison, and linear editions
epics.disposition: Bounded native dispatch, receipts and renders exist. General cancellation/cache/resume support, renderer equivalence, native handoff acceptance and final edition acceptance are not inferred.

epics.title: Generative recomposition and variant selection
epics.disposition: Three seeded schedules and render evidence exist; eligible word/gesture qualification, dramatic evaluation and selected authored outcome remain acceptance work.

epics.title: Interactive reception and installation delivery
epics.disposition: Shared-clock control schedules and replay exist. A score is not a complete wall-clock interaction recording. Hosted/mobile/Safari, audience evaluation, state migration and real venue calibration remain separate gates.
